vacancy.title: Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer (8+ Years)
vacancy.description:
Job Description

Job Description – Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer

Experience: 8–10 Years

Location: Remote

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Asset Collection: Mumbai / Chennai / Bangalore / Gurgaon

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Java & Node.js Backend Developer with 8–10 years of strong hands-on experience in backend application development, microservices architecture, API development, event-driven systems, and cloud technologies.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Microservices, Kafka, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, AWS, Docker, OpenShift, Jenkins, and API security . Experience with communication platforms such as Email and SMS is an added advantage.

The candidate should also demonstrate practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code Assist , along with an understanding of responsible AI usage, privacy, code provenance, prompting practices, and development guardrails.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance highly scalable backend services and microservices using Java 8–21, Spring Boot, and Node.js v16/v22 .
  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs , including API gateway management using Apigee .
  • Develop and manage event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Apache Kafka, AWS MSK, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain database objects, queries, stored procedures, and performance-critical operations using PostgreSQL and SQL Server .
  • Manage and enhance existing Email and SMS middleware platforms , including support, development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Work with communication platforms such as SparkPost, Twilio, Syniverse , or equivalent technologies.
  • Build and maintain containerized applications using Docker and deploy/manage workloads on OpenShift / ROSA .
  • Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git.
  • Monitor application health, performance, availability, and logs using New Relic and ELK Stack .
  • Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, API security, and other security best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal application teams, vendors, architects, business stakeholders, and other technical teams.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive performance and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while following organizational policies related to privacy, security, prompt patterns, code provenance, limitations, and governance .
  • Provide technical support and guidance to team members and contribute to a collaborative engineering environment.

Required Technical Skills

Must-Have Keywords:

  • Java 8–21
  • Spring Boot
  • Microservices
  • Node.js v16/v22
  • Apache Kafka / AWS MSK
  • PostgreSQL
  • SQL Server
  • REST APIs
  • Apigee
  • Docker
  • OpenShift / ROSA
  • Jenkins
  • Git
  • New Relic
  • ELK Stack
  • HTML5
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • AWS
  • AI-Assisted Development Tools – Claude Code Assist / GitHub Copilot

Good to Have

  • Experience with SparkPost, Twilio, Syniverse , or similar Email/SMS communication platforms.
  • Experience working on high-volume messaging and communication middleware platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native application development and AWS services.
  • Experience with production support, application performance optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of secure software development practices and API governance.

AI-Assisted Development Experience

Candidates should have demonstrated experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools into their daily engineering workflows, including:

  • GitHub Copilot, Claude Code Assist, or equivalent AI coding assistants.
  • Effective prompt patterns for software development and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of AI-generated code limitations and validation requirements.
  • Awareness of privacy, security, governance, and code-provenance considerations.
  • Ability to review, test, validate, and appropriately govern AI-generated code.

Job Title - Software Engineer- 2 (Backend)

Location - Bangalore

Tazapay is a cross border payment service provider. They offer local collections via local payment methods, virtual accounts and cards in over 70 markets. The merchant does not need to create local entities anywhere and Tazapay offers the additional compliance framework to take care of local regulations and requirements. This results in decreased transaction costs, fx transparency and higher auth rates.

They are licensed and backed by leading investors.

vacancy.title: Senior C++ Backend Engineer — Low-Latency, Remote
vacancy.description:
We’re currently hiring Senior C++ Engineers to work on the systems underpinning a global proprietary trading firm.

This is a backend engineering role focused on building and optimising low-latency infrastructure operating under real production load. The work sits close to the trading side of the business and centres around performance, reliability, throughput, and systems scalability.

The environment is highly technical and engineering-driven, with a strong focus on solving complex infrastructure and optimisation problems.

The Role

You’ll be working on the core systems supporting live trading activity globally, including market data infrastructure, exchange connectivity, and performance-critical backend services.

The team is growing quickly from both a trading and infrastructure perspective, creating increasing demand for engineers who can design, optimise, and maintain low-latency systems at scale.

If you enjoy working on systems where microseconds matter and reliability is critical, this could be a strong fit.

Responsibilities

• Build and optimise low-latency backend infrastructure supporting live trading systems.

• Develop high-performance market data and exchange connectivity services.

• Improve throughput, latency, and resilience across distributed systems operating under real production load.

• Work closely with engineering and trading teams on performance-critical infrastructure initiatives.

• Debug and resolve complex systems and performance bottlenecks across live environments.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong modern C++ experience within backend or systems engineering environments.

• Experience building high-performance, low-latency, or high-throughput systems.

• Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and distributed systems concepts.

• Experience working within Linux environments.

• Strong debugging and performance optimisation capabilities.

• Good understanding of networking and infrastructure-level engineering concepts.

• Exposure to trading systems, market infrastructure, HFT, or exchange environments.

Why This Role

• Performance-critical engineering problems with direct business impact.

• Lean, highly technical environment.

• High ownership and autonomy.

• Close proximity to the trading side of the business.

• Flexible working hours and healthy work-life balance.

• Remote setup with globally distributed engineering teams.

• Yearly company vacations with the wider team.
